trans-unit.source: Well, well, I hear you're lookin' to marry some rich dude.
trans-unit.target: Well, well, I hear you're lookin' to marry some rich dude.

trans-unit.source: So!? Get out of my business, you nosy jerk!
trans-unit.target: So!? Get out of my business, you nosy jerk!

trans-unit.source: Where're you going to find a guy like that who's naive enough to give you the time of day?
trans-unit.target: Where're you going to find a guy like that who's naive enough to give you the time of day?

trans-unit.source: That's for me to know! Besides, you shouldn't be talking.
trans-unit.target: That's for me to know! Besides, you shouldn't be talking.

trans-unit.source: Now, if I was getting married,
trans-unit.target: Now, if I was getting married,

trans-unit.source: and there was this manipulative, foul-mouthed, but very spunky girl
trans-unit.target: and there was this manipulative, foul-mouthed, but very spunky girl

trans-unit.source: with a pony tail who flies around everywhere on a broom...
trans-unit.target: with a pony tail who flies around everywhere on a broom...

trans-unit.source: ...I'd turn her down in an instant.
trans-unit.target: ...I'd turn her down in an instant.
